description: The reservoir's literal random recurrent graph -- what the hidden state actually looks like as a network -- with input (MKR clock), hidden reservoir units, and output (predicted EEG channel) nodes, edges thresholded to the strongest by magnitude for legibility.
note: Only the exogenous MKR input gets its own drawn nodes; the much larger NARX delay-embedded output-feedback input block (72 of the 74 total input dims) is intentionally not drawn node-by-node here -- see the paired ch3_3-11_reservoir-architecture figure for that feedback path.

edge_kinds.recurrent: A = W, strongest 3% by |weight| among the 60 sampled hidden units
edge_kinds.input: B = W_in, exogenous MKR channels to sampled hidden units
edge_kinds.readout: C, sampled hidden units to output channels (drawn only once W_out is fit)
